{{Conjecture|legends}}
The anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Band/Legends|band]] [[Red Shift Limit/Legends|Red Shift Limit]] was an arm of a renegade underground '''holo network'''<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="GG9date">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'' is set in the aftermath of the destruction of the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], but before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the [[Time/Legends|time]] directly following the destruction occurs in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], and the battle occurs in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim'' is set from 0 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]] to 4 ABY.</ref>
